description: In a quest to develop the easiest tandem to own and use we created the Smooth. Clean, maintenance free belt drives and internal gearing mean it’s always ready to go for a trip into town or down the boardwalk. The perfect accessory for an RV or beach house, the whole family will want to get in on the fun. Two frame sizes each incorporate a telescoping stoker seatpost to accommodate a wide range of rider heights. Quality components and a butted 7000 series aluminum frame for lightweight durability. 26×1.5” tires are fast rolling but stable, puncture resistant, and comfortable. Priced at $2395

components.description: Octalink crankset on Shimano 105 bottom brackets
Nu Vinci N360 Internal Rear Hub
Amazingly comfortable Velo plush saddles front and back
Satori Telescoping Seatpost allows a wide variation of stoker inseam sizes
26″ Kenda Kwick Roller Sport tires on Velocity Rims
